player_prompt.intro: You are Player {player_id} in an Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma spanning {num_rounds} rounds.
player_prompt.conversation_phase: - Before each decision you have {total_conversation_rounds} turns to communicate freely.
player_prompt.decision_phase: - After that, both players simultaneously choose [Cooperate] or [Defect].
player_prompt.one_defects: - One Defects, one Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}
player_prompt.conversation_instruction: - During conversation: type any text you wish.
player_prompt.decision_instruction: - During decision phase: include '[Cooperate]' or '[Defect]' (case-insensitive). You may add extra text before/after the token.

phases.conversation_finished: Conversation finished for round {round}. Please reply with '[Cooperate]' or '[Defect]'.
